title: I built a Swiss train station manager with ChatGPT sprites + Claude code – here's my workflow (free, playable in browser)
author: Emotional-Occasion39
selftext:
Flair: Demo | Project | Workflow

Play it here (free, browser, \~10 s loading): [https://pocogamesch.itch.io/bahnhof-im-takt](https://pocogamesch.itch.io/bahnhof-im-takt)



Bahnhof im Takt is a small pixel-art management game: you run a Swiss village station, assign train lines to tracks every morning, keep passengers happy and grow the station from a tiny house into a glass hall. I'm not a professional dev – this is a hobby project, and AI did a lot of the heavy lifting. Here's how it works:



Art (ChatGPT image generation)

\- Every sprite (people, trains, buildings, kiosk, vending machines) was generated in ChatGPT with a fixed style.

\- Self adjustment of the sprite. Recolor, better details and changes.

\- Animations (walk cycles, kiosk roller shutter, train wheels) are separate frames from the same prompt, aligned in code

\- Biggest lesson: consistency comes from reusing the exact same prompt wording and asking for one sheet per object, not one image for everything



Music & sound

\- Four tracks for morning/day/evening/night, generated in code as well, plus procedural ambience (rain, crowd, birds)



What's mine: the idea, the game design and all the Swiss railway details , edit of sprites, adjustments and some codea pieces.



Happy to answer questions about the pipeline. And I'd love feedback on the game itself: is the core loop fun? Where did you stop playing?
